Directors
The board of directors of Sanlam celebrate the life of our late Independent Non-Executive Director, Mr. John
Burbidge who passed on. He has been a long serving member of the Board and a dependable member of the
Board Audit, Actuarial, Risk and Compliance Committee that he chaired.
Theuns Botha has resigned from the Board of Sanlam Kenya Plc to take up other roles within the wider
Sanlam Group
Dividends
Consistent with the Company’s dividend policy, the Board does not recommend the payment of an interim dividend.
